Excellent! After 3.Kh3 (or any king move), Black plays 3...Rxc2 winning the rook. 

**Best move: Rxg2+**

Main line: 1...Rxg2+ 2.Kxg2 Rd2+ 3.Kh3 (or other king move) Rxc2 and Black wins the rook.

**Motif: fork** (the move attacks both the king and the pawn simultaneously, forcing the king to move and allowing the other rook to win the undefended rook on c2)

---

**Coaching Note:**

Look for moves that give check while simultaneously attacking something else. Here, Rxg2+ checks the king AND attacks the rook on c2. After the king moves to escape check, your other rook snaps up the undefended rook. When your opponent is under pressure, they often leave pieces hanging while defending against threats. Attack two things at once!
